name: anim_closing
prompt: Gentle cosy children's picture-book animation in the same flat pastel 2D style as the first frame, keep the art style exactly. At night on the front step of a little café, four chibi critter friends (a pink kitten, a red panda, a butter-yellow fox, a sky-blue wolf pup) sit together sleepily. The paper lanterns sway softly, the stars twinkle, the kitten yawns and leans on the red panda's shoulder, the wolf pup's tail wags slowly. Static camera, slow gentle motion. Audio: soft crickets, a quiet music-box lullaby, a tiny contented sigh. No text, no subtitles.
